findings: Route JSONs retain retired IDs and stale summaries. Counts use reviewed delivery boundaries.

bio-m5-b02b route parent covers six delivery parts: flowering plants, runner, mould and three single-celled groups. B02c consolidates yeast, bacteria and protists. Runner has only historic prototypes and remains not started for the current explainer route.
chem-m5-g02 remains Revision 4 design without build. chem-m6-c02 is built without uploaded MP4.
chem-m5-c12 Revision 1 also requires cultural review before voicing, in addition to the three named held Module 7 Biology videos.
Every Public row with a recorded export path uses out/explainer, not the old slide engine. Root should check legacy public videos used as prerequisites or substitutes separately.
Public skill videos sit outside subject route JSONs by design. Shared placements follow Module 7 and 8 reviews.

139 current upload-ledger videos are present in the public playlist readback. No duplicate video ID occurs within the readback playlists. Shared skills are counted separately from subject route videos. Six old Year 11 chemistry public uploads also exist, including the limiting-reactants prerequisite linked by G04.

syllabusAudit.scope: Year 12 Chemistry and Biology, 2017 syllabus, Modules 5 to 8
syllabusAudit.method: Official point IDs and actual route action mappings were matched to existing design files and their scope declarations. Designed means written scope exists; it does not mean public, approved or learner practical conduct. Publication detail is handled by the parent audit. Scope gaps include required sub-actions with no design even when another subject/module video covers part of the parent point. Cross-module partial coverage is recorded explicitly.

checklistFinding.finding: The checklist named by the progression plan covers only 27 Chemistry 2025 Year 11 Quantitative chemistry points and four Biology enzyme points. scopeReferences.text: - **Site alignment:** site lesson 02 (Gibbs free energy, entropy, enthalpy, combustion, entropy-driven reactions) is the source. This video uses its combustion and photosynthesis cards (ideas 4 and 5, key relationships box, "address both delta H and delta S" tip, glucose worked example 2, photosynthesis delta G +2870 on the site, corrected here to +2881). It does not teach the reversibility practical (Fe3+/SCN-, burning magnesium: p01), the Haber process analysis (L07, not used), the ammonium nitrate and calcium carbonate entropy-driven examples (not needed for the two named syllabus examples), or the full "Gibbs and equilibrium" card (delta

- **Scope decision on Gibbs free energy (flag for Claude):** the official 2017 Year 11 Module 4 ("Entropy and Gibbs Free Energy") already teaches delta G = delta H - T delta S, predicting entropy change, and classifying spontaneity. So delta G is **recalled as a tool**, not taught fresh, in one short scene (3). It is the cleanest way to show how heat and spreading combine, and it is what the site and the HSC answer tip expect ("address both delta H and delta S"). All use is qualitative plus simple substitution of supplied values. No delta G = -RT ln K, no delta G = 0 at equilibrium, no Q, no K, no temperature crossover calculation. If Claude

- **Scope:** keep delta G as a recalled tool (this draft), or strip to enthalpy and entropy only? Gibbs is Year 11 Module 4 (verified in the cached 2017 paragraphs: "Entropy and Gibbs Free Energy", "solve problems using ... Gibbs free energy formula"); p1059-p1061 for Module 5 name only enthalpy and entropy. The site and HSC tip use delta G heavily.

No video can establish that students conducted a required practical, constructed their own model or collected their own data. This audit inventories video support, not student completion.

year11Inventory.scope: Local inventory only. No modules planned and no publication changes.
findings: Chemistry site Modules 1 to 4 contain the 2017 course. Biology Year 11 has three 2025 focus areas, not four legacy modules.
Biology src/data filenames and module fields say Modules 1 to 3, but their syllabusVersion identifies the 2025 course. Do not treat these as a 2017 M1 to M4 route.
No dedicated Year 11 video-route JSON or completed Year 11 explainer design was found. The scoping document and Biology pre-design index are inventories and design inputs.
Biology has 105 pre-design packs across 75 lessons, plus an index. These are not 105 finished designs.
The old-engine audit records six public Year 11 Chemistry videos, all quantitative chemistry. It records no public Year 11 Biology video. Preferred enzyme review ZTxQP7kI5_o is held, not public.
The old archived Biology scripts also identify the 2025 syllabus. Their old folder and module names do not establish legacy Module 4 coverage.
